name: Nose + ear trimmer
lead: A nose and ear trimmer is a small rotary-blade tool that trims hair from the nostrils and ear openings. It is a cheap way to remove visible hair.

Trimming is generally preferred to plucking. Nasal hair is thought to filter particles, and one study associated denser nasal hair with lower asthma rates in seasonal rhinitis, so trimming short rather than removing everything is sensible.

paras: A guarded rotating blade shears hair near the opening while the guard keeps blades from touching the sensitive lining.

Plucking or waxing nasal hair may cause irritation or infection. Over-trimming reduces the filtering role, though the association with asthma is from one observational study and not proof of harm. Blades should be cleaned.

studies.title: Does nasal hair (vibrissae) density affect the risk of developing asthma in patients with seasonal rhinitis?
studies.source: International Archives of Allergy and Immunology
